gaps.explanation: Schedule ABOVE the statement by 159,036 = exactly the Debt Service Fund budget schedule disbursements. Per fund, statement p5 (printed p9) Total expenditures vs detail: General 294,736 = General schedule pp12-13 294,736; Street 472,222 = Street schedule p14 472,222; Cemetery 9,622, Library Board 65,489, Community Ambulance 38,641 = their p5 statement-column lines in detail (pass 6); Other Governmental Funds 112,622 = Swimming Pool 73,865 (own schedule p18: Culture and Recreation 66,632 + Capital improvements 7,233) + Park 31,184 + Library 1,252 + Fitness Center 5,737 + Parks and Recreation Board 584 (nonmajor combining p21; Swimming Pool column of p21 not recorded a second time); Debt Service Fund: statement column blank (0) vs Debt Service budget schedule p16 (printed p42) Total disbursements 159,036 = Bond retirement 105,000 + Interest on bonds 53,636 + Agent fees 400. The governmental funds statement p6 (printed p10) prints the same money under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) in the Debt Service column: Debt principal payments (105,000) and Debt interest payments (54,036) = 53,636 + 400; the JSON statement holds it in other_financing (-254,298), not in disbursements. Detail 294,736 + 472,222 + 159,036 + 73,865 + 31,184 + 1,252 + 5,737 + 584 + 9,622 + 65,489 + 38,641 = 1,152,368 = schedule_total; statement 993,332. Nothing counted twice, nothing missing; the printed schedule lines stay.
